neighbours.label: word pieces of 'minimally invasive' / 'laparoscopic' surgery terms
fire: The surgeon removed the gallbladder laparoscopically through small cuts.
She chose a minimally invasive procedure to repair the hernia.
Laparoscopic surgery usually means a shorter hospital stay.
The clinic offers minimally invasive spine treatment.
His appendix was taken out with a laparoscopic technique.
Recovery after minimally invasive heart surgery is faster.
The cyst was removed laparoscopically last spring.
Our team specialises in minimally invasive thyroid operations.
quiet: The surgeon removed the gallbladder through a large open incision.
She chose a traditional open procedure to repair the hernia.
Open abdominal surgery usually means a longer hospital stay.
The clinic offers physical therapy for spine pain.
His appendix was taken out in an emergency operation.
Recovery after open heart surgery is slower.
The cyst was drained with a needle last spring.
Our team specialises in complex thyroid operations.
